body: on this day in 2020, taylor was set to open SoFi stadium -- lover fest west, july 25 & 26 -- which would have made her the first woman ever to open an NFL stadium. it never happened. that empty summer became folklore instead, and the tour she never played grew up into eras.
why: On-this-day pillar with a real dated match for today (July 25). Sourced from the vault Lover era items (Lover Fest West set for SoFi July 25-26, 2020; the 'first woman to open an NFL stadium' framing; the cancelled summer -> folklore -> Eras Tour arc). Positive, evergreen-adjacent; deliberately omits the cancellation cause (health topic, #36 blocklist) and asserts nothing there.
